notes:
REF-BM-02: Only the page title is collected; description, favicon, and preview image are not.
REF-BM-03: Title and description fields are editable, but collected metadata is not available for editing before save and descriptions are never collected.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-07: List items expose title, description, tags, and URL, but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated field without autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-14: The search parser does not implement #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact matches.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action implementation.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot target all bookmarks matching the current filter.
REF-BM-22: Results always use a fixed newest-first order with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are unsupported.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are unsupported.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is unsupported.
REF-BM-29: Saved reusable filter bundles are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are unsupported.
